# Annual Gala 2026 Campaign

- **Goal / definition of done:** net **$500K** at the fall gala — Keystone's largest single
  fundraising event and a major source of flexible dollars. More urgent now that the
  [Hearthstone grant](hearthstone-grant.md) fell through.
- **Owner:** [Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md); Cam is the public face and lead closer.
- **Status:** **active — planning.** Venue to be confirmed (see [commitments](../commitments.md));
  host committee forming.

## Key elements
- **Case for support** built on the [Spring cohort's](bright-futures-spring.md) 88% college
  enrollment.
- **Table hosts:** cultivating [Sarah Whitman](../people/sarah-whitman.md) to host.
- **Recognition:** honor roll in the program — **exclude [Walter Brennan](../people/walter-brennan.md)**
  per his anonymity rule.

## Open items
- Confirm the venue; lock the date; recruit host committee.
